summary: PRF Technologies filed a Form 6-K furnishing a September 16, 2026 press release announcing that GridFeed, its AI-driven energy optimization platform, will explore the AI/hyperscale data center power-optimization market as a strategic growth opportunity, citing IEA projections that global data center electricity use roughly doubles from 485 TWh in 2025 to 950 TWh by 2030 and AI-focused consumption triples. No transaction, price, stake, advisor, board recommendation, or timeline is disclosed; interim CEO Efraim Cohen-Arazi is quoted. Watch for follow-on commercial partnerships, capital needs, and dilution risk rather than deal terms.
